# cpanel_dav_users (Data Source)

Reads the complete cPanel DAV user and collection inventory through `CPDAVD::list_users`, with a legacy `CCS` fallback only when cPanel reports that `CPDAVD` is unavailable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_dav_users" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The DAV users sorted by complete username. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `collections` (Attributes List) The user's DAV collections sorted by collection name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--collections))
- `username` (String) The complete DAV username.

<a id="nestedatt--users--collections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.collections`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) The collection display name, or an empty string when unavailable.
- `name` (String) The DAV collection identifier.
- `type` (String) The DAV collection type reported by cPanel, such as `VCALENDAR`.
